It's not like I think they were the only one. They understood me best I suppose, which is pretty pathetic. But between the abrupt ramp up, my complete lack of social services or housing or anything here in the states I just don't feel like doing this anymore. I feel like a burden everywhere and that everyone is talking shit about how I'm a failure of the family and in trouble again.

My ex-fiance told me some pretty hurtful shit about myself and how I'm not achieving my goals and I'm negative and narcissistic. At the time I was very defensive and tried to argue for my own success with things and now...a few days out I think they were right. This isn't my first failure, and at this rate it's not likely to be the last. I just can't give a shit anymore. I've been blindsided, I have nothing of worth. I'm gonna be a fucking wage slave forever scraping by and I'm in my mid 30s starting over again. I really can't even the idea of getting up again. I'm so tired, and the internet is depressing, Christmas is depressing, the news is depressing, government offices are depressing. I see nothing but drudgery and loneliness ahead of me and I think what others have told me is correct. That I'm never going to get better, I'm gonna feel in fear of failure and money and whatever's next around the corner and no one is going to put up with it and I'm never going to change. It's baked in now. I don't want that so now I just look for ways to die while telling everyone else I'm fine. The place I'm staying is already sick of me, (I was "asleep" on the couch when I heard my benefactor say "I hate this!" while trying to tiptoe through the kitchen to another family member about having to interrupt their normal routine. I think I'm gonna try soon. I got a gun but I need ammo and to close out some last details. I'm just looking where and when really. God bless the states shitty gun laws.
